decision: Two separable things are decided here. The NW-02 transaction SHAPE is accepted: one transaction, the pre-block failing closed on drift, disable trigger -> drop the three named CHECKs -> update the seven named fields -> add the three CHECKs -> enable trigger, then the post-block, with the nine remaining columns asserted identical on both sides, plus the two guard families the M3 nw02 clause adds beyond NW-01 (R11-F12 and R11-F13). That shape was checked line by line against the M3 clause and against the live catalog and matches. The INSTANCE is rejected and must not be executed. It is rejected for two independent reasons. First, it would pin a subject this session refused: the companion ContinuationRegistrationSubjectAcceptance.json records NW02-R1 against approval.proposal_path, so there is at present no accepted subject for this window. Second, the prepared instance is stale on its own terms: NW02Applied.sql and nw02-parameters.json.postimage.binding would write subject_sha256 338a3487... (superseded by fa4b9ea3...), registration_acceptance_sha256 b422667081... and store_acceptance_sha256 645f886e..., which are the digests of the two skeleton files rather than of any acceptance, and signature_evidence_sha256 0a3dfa95..., which matches no file now in the directory. The drafting session marked all of this itself; it is recorded here so that this acceptance cannot be mistaken for clearance of the file as it stands.
